notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); Taxes and Intergovernmental split by fund column using the fund budget schedules (pp12-17) and the nonmajor combining statement (p21), pieces tie exactly (Taxes 405,221; Intergovernmental 224,333). Debt principal/interest/admin cost are printed under Other Financing Sources (Uses) on p6 and recorded in other_financing; transfers 105,820 in and out (Total column). Fund balance roll-forward 173,325 + 915,926 - 682,831 + 105,820 - 105,820 - 249,570 = 156,850; cash fields null (as FY2023). Business-type lines from the modified cash proprietary statement (p8), which ties to the Statement of Activities business-type column (p2: expenditures 195,097, charges 268,354, interest 246); 648,158 + 268,600 - 195,097 = 721,661. The accrual proprietary statement (p9) and the Statement of Cash Flows (p10) are on a different basis and are not used (measure cash, proprietary null, as FY2023/FY2024). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p4, totals equal the p1 governmental column), business-type lines and totals from p1. Detail: individual fund budget schedules (General pp12-13, Street pp14-15, Debt Service p16, Sales Tax p17, Swimming Pool p18, Water p19, Sewer p20) and the nonmajor combining statement (p21) per fund column; the all-funds budgetary statement (p11) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Lines with blank Actual (General Insurance refund, Law enforcement, Capital outlay; Street Equipment rental expense; Debt Service Refunding; Sales Tax Bond proceeds; Swimming Pool Miscellaneous and Capital improvements; Water Well and pump tests, Supplies, Capital outlay) are omitted. The Debt Service schedule prints bond retirement and interest as disbursements while the fund statement shows them under other financing; detail follows the schedule as printed.
